review.note: 2026-11-04 h2h-dev-tools 0.11.0 dependency review. User explicitly approved the breaking native process identity contract and version 0.11.0. Python >=3.14, PyPI/npm declarations and all bounds remain unchanged; the new implementation uses only standard-library waitid, ctypes and pidfd APIs. Live official PyPI/npm metadata was compared with the accepted 2026-10-31 0.10.5 receipt: hatchling1.33.0, distlib0.4.4, packaging26.3, build1.6.1, mypy2.4.1, pytest9.2.0, pytest-xdist3.8.0, Ruff0.17.3 and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 are unchanged and admitted by existing bounds. No out-of-bound stable version was found. Retained and manually checked the explicitly attributed release-note review in that exact preceding receipt: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/ ; https://distlib.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html#change-log-for-distlib ; https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html ; https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html ; https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html ; https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html ; https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html ; https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.3 ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/v0.24.0/CHANGELOG.md . The unchanged pytest9.2 source-hash cache fixtures, distlib launcher generation and their previous Windows evidence remain historical evidence, not proof of this new candidate. The generated registry audit independently checks non-yanked Python3.14 artifacts; distlib has no Requires-Python but declares3.14 support, xdist uses >=3.9 without a3.14-specific classifier. Node >=22 remains required by markdownlint-cli2. Native POSIX ownership now requires macOS libproc or Linux6.9+ PIDFD_SIGNAL_PROCESS_GROUP, default SIGCHLD and waitid(WNOWAIT); checked upstream XNU proc_listpids and Linux pidfd_send_signal source and the man7 pidfd manual. No new runtime dependency or application-data conversion is introduced. The corrected isolated native candidate passed229 macOS tests with3 Linux skips and99 Linux tests with10 macOS skips on Linux7.0.14; Ruff and strict mypy passed. Final complete-candidate review, full gate, version/artifact validation and native Windows release checks remain required and are not claimed here. Publication is not authorized by this audit.
